minemelody.screen.title: MineMelody
minemelody.screen.waiting: Playlist on: the next track starts shortly
minemelody.screen.disabled: Playlist off: regular game music plays
minemelody.tooltip.enabled: On: your playlist replaces the game music inside worlds. The main menu, the credits and the dragon fight keep their regular music.
minemelody.tooltip.mode: In order, shuffle (no repeats until every track has played) or repeat one track.
minemelody.tooltip.gap: Seconds of silence between tracks. The regular game waits 5 to 20 minutes.
minemelody.tooltip.discs: On: in survival, discs only play if you have had them in your inventory in that world. In creative, all of them are available.
minemelody.tooltip.listen: Click a track in either list and press here to play it right away. Works even with the playlist off. Locked discs can't be previewed.
minemelody.tooltip.banner: Now playing banner: when it shows, which corner and how big (with live preview).
minemelody.tooltip.up: Moves the selected playlist track up.
minemelody.tooltip.down: Moves the selected playlist track down.
minemelody.tooltip.add_all: Adds every available track to your playlist.
minemelody.tooltip.add_favorites: Adds all your favorites (★) to the playlist.
minemelody.tooltip.favorite: Marks or unmarks the clicked track as a favorite. Type "fav" in the search box to see only your favorites.
minemelody.tooltip.export: Copies your playlist to the clipboard as text, to paste it on Discord or anywhere.
minemelody.tooltip.import: Loads a playlist copied with "Export" (yours or a friend's). Replaces the current one.
minemelody.toast.export_empty: Your playlist is empty: nothing to export
minemelody.toast.import_invalid: The clipboard doesn't contain a MineMelody playlist
minemelody.toast.imported_missing: Playlist imported: %s tracks (%s don't exist in your game)
minemelody.import.confirm_message: Your current playlist (%s tracks) will be replaced by the imported one (%s tracks).
minemelody.playlist.name: Playlist name
minemelody.tooltip.playlist_name: Type to rename the playlist. Red means empty or duplicated name (not saved).
minemelody.tooltip.delete_playlist: Deletes this playlist (asks first). At least one must remain.
minemelody.tooltip.dimension: "All": your regular playlist. Bind it to a dimension and it plays automatically there, even if another one is active.
minemelody.delete.confirm_message: Its %s tracks will be removed from the list (the game music itself is not deleted).
minemelody.banner_settings.title: "Now playing" banner
minemelody.banner_settings.preview_hint: The preview shows in the chosen corner
minemelody.tooltip.banner_mode: "When a track starts": a few seconds on every new track. "Always": stays on screen while music plays, with the progress bar.
